items.desc: Open-source personal finance app with an AI financial advisor: track your net worth, investments, ETFs, cash and debts on your own computer.
Open-source version of Scion: version control built for coding agents.
200 interactive UI elements you can try live, then copy as an AI prompt or working code. Light/dark, MIT.

Mission control for AI coding agents. Watch Claude Code, Codex, Gemini and a dozen more work live in one macOS terminal: live status, an editor that follows their edits, undo for any turn, approvals from your phone and local models. 20+ built-in tools, all on the site below. Built on Ghostty.
